title: EMRGNT AI Brief: Pilot, Monday October 12
desc:
This is EMRGNT AI Brief, your quick guide to the AI news that matters for filmmakers, editors and post-production professionals. I'm Brian. A quick note before we start: this show is produced with AI voices. Today is Monday, October twelfth, and we've got five stories for you.

Story one. Netflix has now used AI in some form on around three hundred titles. That figure came from Sung Q Lee, who runs production for Netflix in Asia-Pacific, speaking at the Busan International Film Festival, as reported by The Hollywood Reporter and Variety.
